q06. memo_relation

Defined in the migration schema, e.g.:

```46:51:/bench/repo/store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql
CREATE TABLE memo_relation (
  memo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  related_memo_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(memo_id, related_memo_id, type)
);
```

This table links `memo_id` to `related_memo_id` (with a `type` column, e.g. for references/comments), and is also present in the SQLite and MySQL migration schemas, and used by `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` (and equivalents) in the store driver layer.
